name: The McKinlock household at 1712 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_mckinlock_george_a

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1712 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903); the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904) prints nothing at 1712. The household left within that year, and whether it was still in the house on 1 July 1904 is not documented.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1712. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The two live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: G. A. McKinlock (written "absent"; the family was away on the census day). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Alex. Dumas Jr.

born.note: The census gives December 1859, age 41 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Butler" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (butler); born December 1859 (the figures are hard to read), in Louisiana, married. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading. The census records the color column as B.
